scope: Formal Single-BV and Dual-BV conditional critical-sequence PPO with Q_S=alpha and state LR=1; transferable Q_S development stopped by user direction
single_selection: Independent best single actor by natural supported absolute-risk mass among nearest eight / 115m; actor-ID tie break
dual_selection: Original locked strict-B pair at the same initial state
actor_assignment: Selected one/two actor identities remain fixed through the four-second episode; re-evaluate their action law before each native decision
action_teacher: Uniform nonempty supported absolute-risk bin then uniform supported action cell; one-dimensional for Single-BV and joint for Dual-BV; remaining-horizon reactive clearance proxy
checkpoint_selection: Predeclared iteration 100; no validation-based checkpoint or seed selection
evaluation_boundary: 270000-270255 remain reserved for a separately locked native evaluation of these completed policies. Previous consumed validation and final test never enter training.
budget_rule: Retain all fixed-schedule endpoints and negative states. No event-dependent extension, source rebalancing, learned state proposal, forced/branching label export or weight clipping. Six PPO runs use the same two complete real-Q datasets.
